subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: For each durable driver round — one cycle identified by a fresh `drive_round_id` from exact combined-frontier read through persisted decisions and either one settled selected-frontier executor invocation or a persisted no-launch exhausted/unknown decision, with duplicate wakes coalesced into that cycle — the wake consumer shall select every in-scope pending obligation whose `recovery_count < recovery_bound`. If and only if that selected set is non-empty, it shall append-first increment each member's recovery count and issue exactly one review-only executor invocation carrying the round ID and selected IDs; a preflight/factory/auth failure still consumes admission even if the provider creates no attempt. `recovery_count == recovery_bound` is exhausted and excluded; when every pending obligation is exhausted, the round appends/replays EVT-7 evidence and launches nothing. The provider scans only the selected frontier and admits at most one attempt per member; the invocation performs zero implementation operations. Authenticated verification clears the await and closes recovery state; failure/interruption remains pending/red; exhaustion remains stale/escalated until explicit operator rearm creates a new epoch without erasing the old one.
rationale: one sweep per obligation races an N-item provider scan; provider attempts miss setup failures; an all-exhausted frontier must not manufacture an empty sweep
fit_criterion: multi-obligation and empty-implementation fixtures produce at most one sweep per round, one decision/count increment per selected obligation, and at most one provider attempt each; truth tables at 0, bound−1, bound plus duplicate-wake, all-exhausted, mixed eligible/exhausted, preflight, crash edges, restart, rearm, forgery, and infrastructure prove exact arithmetic, immutable prior epochs, zero provider preflight/attempt/implementation on all-exhausted, and no clean pending/exhausted result
